text:
Alex K: Quick async check — we're prepping the pricing/packaging rollout but the quota schema change is blocking metering and billing. Who owns contract sign-off for the rounding/clause change? @Maria T?
Maria T: I can own contract language. Need the exact fields we'll change on the ratecard (rounding behavior + per-unit vs per-call). Can someone paste the expected payload?
Devin L: Metering side expects `units_consumed` integer; the new proposal moves to `granular_units` + `unit_scale`. PR #482 updates ingestion but CI is failing on integration tests (schema mismatch).
Samir R: I'll take the CI fix. Quick note: the migration job in the ingestion repo expects a backfill window and may slow down dedicated throughput — we need an outage plan or a rolling migration.
Priya N: For Dedicated customers we need an explicit 'burst allowance' clause in contracts or risk SLA violations during migration. Legal will want the clause text before we flip the flag.
Alex K: Milestone: M2 deploy (packaging + metering) by Fri COB. Can we hit merge by Thu morning for canary on Friday? If not, we push milestone.
Devin L: Merge blocker is the contract-dependent toggle: feature flag `pricing_v2` reads `contract.allow_granular_billing`. If the contract lacks the clause, we must fallback to legacy rounding. Need product confirmation on fallback behavior.
Maria T: Fallback to legacy rounding OK for existing contracts. New contracts should default to granular when clause present. I'll draft a templated clause and ping legal.
Samir R: CI fix pushed to branch `metering/ci-fix-482` — it resolves the schema mismatch and adds a dry-run mode for the migration. Can someone review? @Devin L @Alex K
Devin L: Reviewing now. Running local dry-run showed ~2% discrepancy on historical usage due to rounding differences. We should run the dry-run for a representative week and surface the divergence to finance.
Priya N: Tagging finance: the delta matters for reserved capacity customers. Can we include a safeguard flag `audit_only` that prevents billing changes and only logs deltas?
Alex K: Good call — add `audit_only` to the migration job. We won't flip billing until legal + finance sign-off.
Maria T: I'll circulate clause + change log by EOD and set a Monday deadline for legal review.
Samir R: Canary plan: staging -> 10% internal -> 5 customers -> full. Migration holds `audit_only` for the first two stages.
Devin L: I requested a CR for the migration and added the dry-run output to the PR. Please comment on edge cases (zero-usage, micro-billing).
BillingBot: [automated] ratecard_v2 draft uploaded (id: rc_2027_draft) — checksum 9f3a1b.
Alex K: Owners: metering (Devin), billing infra (Samir), contracts (Maria), rollout coordination (Priya). Any objections?
Priya N: No objections. I'll coordinate the calendar invites for the canary window (Fri 09:00-12:00 PT) and the finance review (Mon 11:00 PT).
Alex K: Final asks: Maria -> clause draft, Samir -> migration `audit_only` flag, Devin -> run 1-week dry-run and attach results, Priya -> schedule canary + finance. Ping me when PRs are green. :thumbsup:
Maria T: Ack. Will post the clause doc link once uploaded.
Devin L: Will post dry-run CSV in the PR comments.
Samir R: Will cut a small release with the `audit_only` toggle today.
BillingBot: [automated] migration job `dry-run` started (id: mj_778) — results will be posted to the PR.
